descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

自从在[Root.Capital.GetName]之外发现了造物的奇迹，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]神秘学家们不断举办神秘仪式，试图得到更多的答案。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms discovered some time ago.

[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] theologians have been partaking in arcane rites since this first sign that divine providence extends outside of [Root.Capital.GetName], attempting to find new answers.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

尽管它离智慧生物还有很大差距，但至少说明外星是有生命存在的。这是一个无法回避的现实，人们开始担心未来。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms discovered some time ago.

While far from intelligent, there is life out there. An inescapable reality, and a deeply unsettling prospect.

descriptions.zh:

这一生命的奇迹再次使[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的人们对第一次接触其他智慧生物满怀期待。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms discovered some time ago.

These little evolutionary marvels kindle in the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] people a renewed hope of first contact with intelligent beings.

descriptions.en: Alien microbes of an organic nature have been detected. Models for the probability of organic alien sapients have been adjusted accordingly. If they exist, they will be found. They will be exterminated.

descriptions.zh: 我们确认了[Root.Capital.GetName]的生物圈之外存在低等有机生命。
descriptions.en: We have confirmed the existence of lower forms of organic life outside of [Root.Capital.GetName]'s biosphere.

descriptions.zh:
我们并不孤独。[Root.GetName]第一次确定了宇宙中有其他生命的存在；微生物、外星生命，但[Root.GetHomeWorldName]并不是唯一一个演化的舞台。

一种莫名的饥渴从长久的沉眠中醒来，在我们的体内躁动不安地搅动。而我们的猎弓再度被拉开了。
descriptions.en:
We are not alone. For the first time, the [Root.GetName] has definitive proof that there is other life in the universe; microscopic, alien life, but [Root.GetHomeWorldName] was not the only planet where evolution occurred.

An instinctive hunger, long dormant, begins to stir within us. Once again, we hunt.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

这些生物似乎居住在深空之中。相比之下，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的极端微生物简直不值一提。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms encountered some time ago.

Seemingly native to deep space, they make the extremophile creatures of [Root.Capital.GetName] appear frail by comparison.

descriptions.zh: 我们观测到了有机极端微生物在深空中遨游。
descriptions.en: We have observed extremophile organics navigating deep space.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]新闻满天飞，内容都是关于不久前发现的外星生物。

这些生物似乎居住在深空之中。相比之下，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的极端微生物简直不值一提。尽管有些人持怀疑态度，但是遇见外星生命基本是意料之中的事情。虽然如此，但[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]外星生物学家仍然抑制不住激动，对这种生命体所承受的种种极端条件感到兴奋不已。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien organisms encountered some time ago.

Seemingly native to deep space, they make the extremophile creatures of [Root.Capital.GetName] appear frail by comparison. While some doubted, encountering alien life was ultimately expected and anticipated - but nothing could have prepared expectant [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] xeno-biologists for the fascinatingly extreme conditions in which this life thrives.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上的人们平静地接收了对异常外星生物的报告。

真空中真的存在生命这一事实在[Root.Capital.GetName]的科学界引起了短暂的争议。不过在此之前已发现过低等生命，因此所有的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都并未感到震惊。
descriptions.en:
The subjects of the [Root.GetName] receive the report of the encounter with new and unusual alien beings with relative calm.

The supposed vacuum habitat of the aliens sparked some short-lived controversy in certain circles of the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName], but the previous discovery of lower forms of life had largely prepared all [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] for the shock.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]遭遇了太空有机体！我们的[GetScientistPlural]还不确定为什么体型如此庞大的生物能够在严苛的宇宙真空中央演化，也不知道这些极端环境中的生物可能拥有何种基因适应性。我们已经迫不及待想知道了。
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetName] has encountered a space organism! Our [GetScientistPlural] do not yet know what caused such massive creatures to evolve in the harsh vacuum of space, nor what kind of genetic adaptations these extremophiles might possess. But we can't wait to find out.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上新闻满天飞，内容都是关于发现的外星生物。

尽管按照[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]标准来说，它们算不上是智慧生物，但它们的存在却否定了我们对生命的简单分类。它们提醒我们，宇宙是如此的复杂，蕴含了无尽的可能。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien life that was found.

While hardly intelligent by [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] standards, the fascinating beings defy easy classification and hint at the immense complexities and possibilities of the universe.

descriptions.zh: 我们在外星星球上发现了动物。
descriptions.en: We have confirmed animal life on an alien world.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]上的教士们普遍对找到外星有机体——虽然较为低等——一事表示了认可。

不过这一发现也引发了对教义的争论——这是可作为[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是万物之主的证明，又或者我们只是还没有在深空之外遇见我们的同胞？
descriptions.en:
The priesthoods on [Root.Capital.GetName] had a generally favorable reaction to the reports of complex - yet dumb - organisms found on alien planets.

The findings did spark some inter-doctrinal debate - is this proof that the [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are the lords of all within creation, or have we simply not yet encountered our brethren from beyond the void?

descriptions.zh:
在外星生物报告发布之后，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]外星生物学家欣喜地发现这一复杂的生命体与[Root.Capital.GetName]上的并没有太大的不同。

这一生命物的出现否定了我们对生命的简单分类，但是它除了纯粹的动物本能之外也没有什么特别之处。尽管如此，它却告诉我们，生命的某些形式是普遍存在的。
descriptions.en:
Following previous reports on alien life, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] xeno-biologists are pleased to learn to complex life forms that appear not too different from what we would find on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The beings still defy easy classification and hardly possess anything more than purely animal instincts, but their existence does indicate that some patterns of life are indeed universal.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { OR = { has_country_flag = Story1 has_country_flag = Story2 } }

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]发现了新的复杂生命形式！这些生物可能不具备完全的只能，但我们的文明对各种各样的染色体样品总是来者不拒。

我们的[GetScientistPlural]已经着手计算需要多少数量的基因物质才足够让我们所有的人口都分一杯羹了。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered a new form of complex life! These creatures may not possess true sapience, but our civilization has always enjoyed sampling from a wide range of genomes.

Already, our [GetScientistPlural] are calculating the amount of genetic material needed to provide everyone with a taste.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]上新闻满天飞，内容都是不久前遭遇的外星生物。

这一生命体已经接近智慧生物了，真是令人兴奋不已。但我们也要清楚地认识到，尽管[Root.GetName]才刚刚登上星系的舞台，但这一切已经是相当大的进展。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien beings encountered some time ago.

Their near-intelligence is fascinating, and it is sobering to realize that while the [Root.GetName] may only just have made its entrance on the galactic stage, we have already come a long way.

descriptions.zh: 我们确认了即将进化出自我意识的外星生物的存在。
descriptions.en: We have confirmed the existence of alien lifeforms on the evolutionary brink of consciousness.

descriptions.zh:
遭遇外星生命后，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]宗教事务团体纷纷奔走相告。

该生物的智慧令人叹为观止。我们还要清楚地认识到，也许[Root.GetName]才刚刚登上星系的舞台，但这已经是相当大的进展。[Root.Capital.GetName]上出现了激烈的争论，如果他们已经有了足够智慧并准备探索星空，我们到底应不应该为其引路。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] congregations are buzzing with activity following news of the alien beings encountered some time ago.

The creatures' intelligence is fascinating, and it is sobering to realize that while the [Root.GetName] may only just have made its entrance on the galactic stage, we have already come a long way. There is heated debate on [Root.Capital.GetName] whether it would be our place to shepherd these creatures, should they ever achieve sapience and reach for the stars.

descriptions.zh:
观测到外星动物一事在[Root.Capital.GetName]上造成了恐慌。视频中有一些东西——它们沉重的脚步和空洞的眼神——引起了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]民众深深的不安。

它们是不是外星的并不重要，重要的是外星生物学家们坚定地认为它们和我们非常相似。这简直就是一个扭曲的镜像，向[Root.GetName]展示着我们试图遗忘的，步履蹒跚的进化之路。
descriptions.en:
The alien animals that were observed are cause for some consternation on [Root.Capital.GetName]. There is something in the video feeds - of their plodding gait and blank stares - that deeply disturbs the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] populace.

Perhaps it is not their alien nature that concerns, but the xeno-biologists' insistence that they are very much like us. A warped mirror image of a shambling evolutionary past that the [Root.GetName] would rather forget.

descriptions.zh:
在遭遇外星生命后，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]新闻网铺天盖地的都是人们对此事的争论。

该生物的智慧令人叹为观止。我们还要清楚地认识到，尽管[Root.GetName]才刚刚登上星系的舞台，但这一切已经是相当大的进展。大多数[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都同意我们有责任和义务帮助其他的物种踏上同样的道路，不过前提是他们已经做好了准备。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] newsnets are ablaze with discussion and debate over the alien beings encountered some time ago.

The creatures' intelligence is fascinating, and it is sobering to realize that while the [Root.GetName] may only just have made its entrance on the galactic stage, we have already come a long way. Most [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] agree that it is an obligation and our moral duty to help other races make the same journey, when they are ready.

descriptions.zh:
多次发现低等生物后，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]首都收到的消息称他们观察到一种非常神奇同时具有莫大进化潜力的生物。

此报告受到了极大的重视。
descriptions.en:
Following previous discoveries of lower forms of life, the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capital receives news of the observation of beings with impressive, if latent, cognitive capabilities and great evolutionary potential.

The report is received with marked enthusiasm.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了也只是全新的外星生命形式。这些生物比[GetHomeWorldName]上生活着的打大多数生命都要复杂，具有接近智慧水平的智力。我们已经开始建立必要的后勤和克隆程序来处理这些诱人的新基因组。
descriptions.en: We have uncovered a new form of alien life. These creatures are more complex than most of those that live on [GetHomeWorldName], with an intelligence that borders on sapience. We have already begun to establish the logistical and cloning routines necessary to process these tantalizing new genomes.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的人对新近发现外星遗迹的消息议论纷纷。

这些痕迹被视为外星人曾经存在并活跃过的铁证——我们现在虽然是孤独的，但至少我们不是第一个踏上星空的。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the alien remnants that were recently studied.

These remains are considered definitive proof of intelligent, purposeful alien activity at some point in the past - we may still be alone now, but we are at least not the first to be so.

descriptions.zh: 我们在异星上发现了智慧外星生物存在的证据。
descriptions.en: We have confirmed the first material traces of intelligent alien life on a foreign world.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]上的有关部门对近日收到的关于外星遗迹的报告表示了一定忧虑。

这些痕迹被广泛视为某种生命曾经活跃于宇宙的舞台上的铁证，不过一些著名的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]专家认为这些痕迹其实只是地质构造现象或者大自然的自然变化。
descriptions.en:
The administration on [Root.Capital.GetName] received the report on the alien remnants with some apprehension.

The remains in question are now widely considered to be definitive proof of unknown forces once having been active in the galaxy, though some prominent [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] thinkers reject this in favor of identifying the traces as "freak geological formations" or "results of curious natural phenomena."

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]外星研究学家们很激动地发表了他们对近期外星生命发现的看法。

这阵科学界的风暴对其他领域造成了暂时的负面影响。
descriptions.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesAdj] xenologists are practically falling over themselves to publish their takes on the recent findings of alien life.

This fevered storm in the scientific community has had some negative, yet temporary, impact on pursuits in other fields.

descriptions.zh:
“智能生物找不到伴”一则热门的新闻文章出现在[Root.Capital.GetName]上。[Root.GetName]的人们认为大家的注意力都集中在一些低等外星生物上，而真正有智能的外星种群却依然“戴着它们神秘的面纱”。

最近发现关于外星生物痕迹的报告似乎只是为整件事情增添了一些讽刺意味。
descriptions.en:
"Intelligent life taunts with pointed absence" reads a popular newsnet post on [Root.Capital.GetName]. The people of the [Root.GetName] are apparently finding some humor in the fact that lower forms of alien life are now a matter of public record, but potential equals from other stars continue to elude us.

The report on the traces of alien life that were recently found seemingly only add an ironic twist to the situation.

我们的舰队发现[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的消息传遍了[Root.GetName]。

虽然仍未掌握太空旅行的能力，但[primitive_planet.GetName]上的外星人已具有足够的智慧，而且他们的社会也具备了先进文明的所有特征。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] is abuzz with news of the [GetPreFTLLower] alien civilization found by our fleets.

They may not be capable of space-flight, but the aliens of the [primitive_planet.GetName] are quantifiably intelligent and their society shows all the hallmarks of a moderately advanced culture.

descriptions.zh: 我们确认了[GetPreFTLLower]外星文明的存在。他们仍不具备超光速旅行能力，被自身分裂的个性所阻碍。
descriptions.en: We have confirmed the existence of a [GetPreFTLLower] alien culture. They have yet to develop FTL capability, handicapped as they are by their fragmented individuality.

descriptions.zh:
[GetPreFTLLower]生物，也就是所谓的[primitive_planet.GetName]文明，它们展现出基础智慧的新闻在[Root.Capital.GetName]上并不受人待见。

一种深刻的不安情绪弥漫在公共辩论中，少数人大声疾呼，主张要不择手段建立[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]对外星星球的霸权，而大多数[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]似乎不愿意提起外星生物或完全忘记它们。
descriptions.en:
News of the [GetPreFTLLower] creatures exhibiting rudimentary intelligence - the so-called civilization of [primitive_planet.GetName] - is not received well on [Root.Capital.GetName].

A profound sense of unease permeates the public debate, as a vocal minority advocates establishing [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] hegemony over the alien planet by any means necessary, while most [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would seemingly prefer to avoid the alien creatures or forget about them entirely.

descriptions.zh:
我们舰队观测到[GetPreFTLLower]文明的报告得到了[Root.GetName]上的学术精英们在维持自己体面的范围内最大限度的狂欢庆贺。

于此，我们终于可以证明[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]走向漆黑星空的试探性一步并不会一无所获。他们也许暂时比不上我们，甚至我们这一辈的人都不会跟他们直接交流，但光是他们存在本身都是一盏能够照亮这个空荡荡静悄悄的宇宙的希望明灯。
descriptions.en:
The report on the [GetPreFTLLower] civilization observed by our fleets is received with something as close to exultant jubilation as the academic elite of the [Root.GetName] will allow themselves to express.

Here, finally, is proof that the first tentative [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] steps into the darkness of space were not for naught. They may not be our equals, not yet, and it may be that we will not interact directly with them in our lifetimes, but their mere existence is a beacon of hope in a galaxy that otherwise appears deadened and unmoving.

descriptions.zh:
发现智慧外星生命令[Root.Capital.GetName]的科学界欢呼雀跃。

尽管仍未掌握太空旅行的能力，但[primitive_planet.GetName]上的外星人已具有足够的智慧，而且他们的社会也具备了先进文明的所有特征。著名外星研究学者表示，之前只能研究古代的遗迹，而现在确是一次研究外星社会的绝好机会。
descriptions.en:
The scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] is excited to receive the report on intelligent alien life.

They may not be capable of space-flight, but the aliens of [primitive_planet.GetName] are quantifiably intelligent and their society shows all the hallmarks of a moderately advanced culture. Prominent xenologists note that this is an excellent opportunity to study a society perhaps not unlike the ones we have previously only found ancient remains of.

descriptions.zh:
发现[GetPreFTLLower]文化的报告受到了[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]研究者们的欢迎，而这一发现紧跟在发现未开化物种之后。

[Root.GetName]目前是我们知道的首个踏上星空的文明，但是发现有其他文明仅仅落后我们数个纪元甚至只是数个世纪真的让人非常激动。
descriptions.en:
The report on a [GetPreFTLLower] culture is welcomed by [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] researchers, following previous discoveries relating to pre-sapient species.

As far as we are aware the [Root.GetName] is the first civilization to take to the stars, but it is fascinating to learn that some other cultures may only be a few millennia, or possibly even centuries, behind.

descriptions.zh: 相比往常发现的非智慧生命，这次我们的舰队发现了[GetPreFTLLower]外星种群[primitive_planet.GetName]的报告无疑重新燃起了[Root.Capital.GetName]对外星科学的兴趣，在此之前这个领域向来被视为不过是纸上谈兵。
descriptions.en: Effectively capping off previous discoveries of lower forms of life, the report on the [GetPreFTLLower] aliens of [primitive_planet.GetName], encountered by our fleets has reignited interest in the xenological sciences on [Root.Capital.GetName], previously considered a largely theoretical field.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了智慧生物！我们的一艘飞船遇见了一个[GetPreFTLLower]文明，这说明我们在虚空之中并不孤独。此外我们还缺人了他们的染色体很适合吸收。

我们已经考虑了无数选项，包括精心计算的观测或者直接的入侵。我们的关系最终会变成什么样还有待观察，但种种可能性毫无疑问相当可口。
descriptions.en:
We have discovered intelligent life! One of our vessels encountered a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization, which proves that we are not alone in the void. We have also confirmed that their genome is ripe for absorption.

Already, numerous options are being considered, from calculated observation to outright invasion. What form our relationship eventually takes remains to be seen, but the possibilities are certainly appetizing.

label.zh: 棒极了。将它们加入到我们的索引库。
label.en: Excellent. Add them to our catalog.

label.zh: 新的生命能带来有价值的科学洞见。
label.en: New life offers valuable scientific insights.

label.zh: 我们与宇宙天人一体。
label.en: We are one with the cosmos.

label.zh: 做好接触潜在威胁的准备。
生命的存在拓宽了我们的理解。
label.en: The existence of life expands our understanding.

label.zh: 我们必须称霸寰宇。
拥抱新生命的纽带。
label.en: Embrace the bonds of new life.

label.zh: 强化我们的防御以备不测。
label.en: Fortify our defenses against the unknown.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]没过多久便遭遇了外星智慧生命。

舰队发给[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]首都的报告很简单随意地描述了这些生物，还顺口提到了错失跟它们交流的机会。
descriptions.en:
It did not take long for the [Root.GetName] to come across intelligent alien life.

The fleet's report to the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] capital somewhat understates just how alien these forces appear, and only in passing mentions the failure to open comms.

descriptions.zh: 我们遭遇了高等外星生命。接触似乎不可避免。
descriptions.en: We have encountered advanced alien life. Contact seems inevitable.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.Capital.GetName]在收到发现未知飞船的消息后彻底沸腾了。

目前尚不知道对方的目的，所以还是做好应对最坏情况的准备。
descriptions.en:
[Root.Capital.GetName] is in an uproar following the news of unidentified ships sighted in the void.

Their intentions unknown, it would be prudent to assume the worst.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]终于遭遇了星空中的其他流浪者。

虽然不知道这些外星人的意图，但是[Root.Capital.GetName]在收到舰队的报告后简直可用四海欢腾来形容。终于有人可以来见证一切了！
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has finally encountered fellow wanderers among the stars.

Whatever the intentions of these aliens, the atmosphere on [Root.Capital.GetName] can best be described as rapturous. At last, someone to bear witness!

descriptions.zh:
我们遭遇了可以进行太空航行的智慧生命。

跟之前[Root.GetName]观察到的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]物种不同，我们甚至还未能看清楚这些驾驶着飞船穿越深空的生物，也不清楚他们的目的。
descriptions.en:
We have now encountered intelligent life capable of space-flight.

In sharp contrast to the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] previously observed by the [Root.GetName], we have yet to get a good look at the beings piloting the crafts that move through the dark with purpose unknown.

descriptions.zh: 外星人飞船的消息传到了[Root.Capital.GetName]之后，可说是为[Root.GetName]踏往群星帝国的初章画上了一个圆满的句号。
descriptions.en: News of alien ships humming through the ether has reached [Root.Capital.GetName], in many ways ending the first chapter of the [Root.GetName]'s bid for a stellar empire.

descriptions.zh: 我们曾观察到拥有先进航天能力的外星飞船经过。尽管仍未与其取得联系，但可以确定我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不是星系中唯一有能力探索太空的帝国。
descriptions.en: We have observed the passage of alien vessels capable of advanced spaceflight. While communications have not yet been established, we can confirm that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are not the only empire in the galaxy capable of stellar exploration.

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了具有太空航行能力的生命。

这一里程碑式的发现点燃了许多哲学和伦理争论：如果这些生物包含着能吸收的基因，我们应该强取豪夺，还是礼貌索要呢？只需要对自愿给予的样本进行克隆就足以满足我们整个人口所需的物质。

与这些有智慧的探索者们第一次接触的结果应该会帮助我们解答这些问题。
descriptions.en:
We have encountered life capable of space-flight.

This momentous discovery has accelerated many philosophical and ethical debates: if these creatures possess genes we can absorb, should we take them by force, or do we ask politely? Cloning freely-given samples could provide us with enough material for our entire population.

The result of first contact with these intelligent explorers should help determine the answer.

descriptions.zh: 有消息称在太空深处遭遇到了一个无比浩大的构筑，它正在延展贯穿整个[Root.GetName]。虽然它看起来并非是某种生物，不过其存在还是彰显了包含技术和巨型工程的可能性。
descriptions.en: News of the encounter with a deep-space construct of gargantuan proportion is spreading throughout the [Root.GetName]. While the entity does not appear to be of biological nature, its mere existence has inescapable ramifications for the possibilities of technology and mega-engineering.

descriptions.zh:
在虚空中发现巨大生物一事使得[Root.GetName]在浩瀚之中显得更加微不足道了。我们伟大的帝国遇到的这第一只庞然大物很可能就是我们遭遇最后一只。这只巨兽的影像已经传遍了整个帝国，造成了极大恐慌，不少人要求政府采取行动。

我方舰队的报告表明，这只巨兽的力量足以轻松摧毁宇宙中最为强大的舰队，建议我们小心行事。
descriptions.en:
The discovery of a giant monstrosity living in the void has made the [Root.GetName] appear all the more insignificant in the grand scheme of things. The first creature our proud empire encounters might just be its last. The leviathan's image has spread across the empire, causing mass hysteria and pleas for action.

Our fleet's report stated that the beast appears powerful enough to crush even the most capable armada, and recommends caution.

descriptions.zh:
在深空中发现特性不明的巨大个体迫使[Root.GetName]重新定义已知敌对单独个体的最大表面面积相关的参数。[Root.GetName]与新发现的该个体发生冲突时的生存率预测并不容乐观。

建议科研与战斗单位继续观察，并对我们已有舰队的规格进行升级。
descriptions.en:
The discovery of a massive entity with unknown properties in the void has forced the [Root.GetName] to redefine all known parameters for the maximum surface area of any single construct with hostile capabilities. Survival rate projections should the [Root.GetName] come into conflict with the newly discovered entity are not promising. 

Scientific and military units recommend continued observation, and specification upgrades to our existing armada.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的民众都在祈祷。黑暗中的巨怪使得帝国中的很多人开始质疑自己的神志是否清晰，甚至还有些人对神灵的宗教事务都开始动摇了。这些巨怪到底是生命的创造者和守护者，还是宇宙万物的敌人？
descriptions.en: The [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] populace is praying. The giant being encountered in the dark has caused many a denizen of the empire to fear for their sanity, or doubt their faith in the divine. Are these giants the guardians of all life and that which created it, or its enemy?

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]遇到了十分庄严崇高的存在。这种巨型生物的存在本身，就是宇宙孕育的无穷奇迹的最佳证明。在这巨型生物的身旁，任何生物都会显得无比渺小，一如腐草荧光安能与日月同辉。

虽说这种巨型生物的行为方式尚不明确，[Root.Capital.GetName]的民众却在敬畏的同时抱有希望，对于这巨兽将带来的一切十分期待。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has encountered something that is beyond sublime. Giant beings, their sheer existence a testament to the unfathomable wonders of the universe, that make most lifeforms appear like flickering lights next to burning stars.

Despite the true nature of the leviathan being unknown, the people on [Root.Capital.GetName] are hopefully in awe of what has been found, and optimistic about what it may bring.

descriptions.zh:
我们找到了一些发展水平超越之前遭遇过的一切物种的生物。这种生物可以生长到前所未见的规模，体积和质量甚至可以与星球的卫星相比。

真可谓是防不胜防。这一天将永远标示着[Root.GetName]历史的转折点。我们只希望我们种群还能存活到回顾此事的那一天。
descriptions.en:
We have now found beings far surpassing anything encountered in our empire's spacefaring history. Life capable of growing to an unprecedented scale, rivaling moons in size and mass.

Nothing could have prepared us for this. This day will forever mark a turning point in the story of the [Root.GetName]. Let us hope we survive long enough to tell it.

descriptions.zh: 近期，有关一只巨兽出没在黑暗虚空之中的消息席卷了整个帝国。有人表示关注，有人表示乐观，但最多的人还是表示恐惧。历史文档中将会着重记录这重要的一天。
descriptions.en: News of a giant being seen in the dark void of space is spreading across the empire like a plague. There is concern and optimistic wonder, but mostly brings an existential dread to the populace. Historical documents will record this day as one of tremendous importance.

label.zh: 难道就只有这黑暗了吗？
label.en: Is this darkness all that exists?

label.zh: 我们只是尘埃虫豸之辈而已。
label.en: We are but motes of dust.

label.zh: 真是大开眼界啊。
信息已收到。正在更新数据库。
考验我们信仰的魔鬼。
神圣的证明。
想想他们能教我们什么。
label.en: Imagine what they could teach us.

label.zh: 想象一下它们能成为多么壮观的战利品啊。
label.en: Imagine how impressive of a trophy it could be.

descriptions.zh:
太空变形虫——这个昵称现在已经传遍了[Root.Capital.GetName]的大街小巷——是一种独居的生物。成年的太空变形虫身边总会伴随着一种被称为鞭毛的半独立生物。鞭毛由变形虫自行生成，并通过分泌液态RNA来进行控制。

我们一度误以为这就是太空变形虫的幼体，但其实这些鞭毛并不含有繁殖器官，每个鞭毛更像是变形虫向外延伸的肢体。这些鞭毛可以在一定范围内离开主体并攻击敌人，但每隔一段时间就需要回返主体内进行重构。

太空变形虫厚皮的再生特性，或鞭毛的精巧的运动模式都有着潜在的军事应用价值。
descriptions.en:
The Space Amoebas - the nickname now lovingly popularized on [Root.Capital.GetName] - are solitary animals, when left to their own devices. All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent organisms, dubbed flagella, seemingly spawned by the Amoeba and programmed through liquid, RNA-laced secretions to do the bidding of the host.

Initially assumed to be young Space Amoebas, the flagella do not seem to factor into any reproductive mechanics, each individual flagellum instead operating solely as a disconnected limb for its host Amoeba. These flagella are capable of manipulating and even attacking objects in an impressive yet restricted range around the host, periodically returning to lodge inside the host Amoeba's body for re-programming.

There are potential military applications to be found in the regenerative properties of the amoeba's thick hide, or in the flagella's graceful patterns of movement.

descriptions.zh: 一只太空变形虫通常伴随着一些半自主的鞭节，用于防御以及移动物体。变形虫与其鞭节并不共享意志，而是前者使用一种带有核糖核酸的分泌物来为后者编程，指引其完成较为复杂的任务。
descriptions.en: A Space Amoeba is usually accompanied by a handful of semi-independent flagella used for defense and object manipulation. The Amoeba and its flagella do not share a mind, the former instead using RNA-laced secretions to program the latter for the execution of tasks of middling complexity.

descriptions.zh:
太空变形虫——当为这种外星生物运用合适的分类方法来确定学名太过麻烦时，这个名称就被[Root.GetSpeciesName]的普罗大众沿用下来——是一种在太空中独居的生物。除了最幼小的那些个体以外，所有我们收集到的样本都拥有半独立的鞭毛和其他有机质，它们由变形虫本身产生并在液态的RNA分泌物中被设计，以方便宿主操纵。这些鞭毛可以被宿主操纵，甚至可以攻击宿主周围巨大但有限范围内的物体，并会定期的缩回变形虫体内，并被重新设计。

太空变形虫厚皮的再生特性，或鞭毛的精巧的运动模式都有着潜在的军事应用价值。
descriptions.en:
The Space Amoebas - the name has stuck as the pronunciation of the proper xeno-taxonomic denominator is too unwieldy for the average [Root.GetSpeciesName] - are solitary animals, when left to their own devices. All but the youngest specimens are accompanied by quasi-independent flagella, organisms spawned by the Amoeba and programmed through liquid, RNA-laced secretions to do the bidding of the host. These flagella are capable of manipulating and even attacking objects in an impressive yet restricted range around the host, periodically returning to lodge inside the host Amoeba's body for re-programming.

There are potential military applications to be found in the regenerative properties of the amoeba's thick hide, or in the flagella's graceful patterns of movement.

label.zh: 这鞭毛还真是奇妙。
取回一些组织样本。

descriptions.zh:
处于太空变形虫群附近时，停止舰只反应核心的某些特定辐射的排放似乎可以避免将其激怒。

由于这一举措，他们已不再将我们视为威胁，我们也因此得以近距离对其进行观察。
descriptions.en:
Temporarily refraining from venting certain emissions from our vessels' reactor cores while in the immediate vicinity of Space Amoebas flocks seems to be enough to not arouse their ire.

With this new protocol in place they no longer pose a threat, and we have been able to study them at close range.

descriptions.zh: 尽管它们是肉食性的，但我们的研究人员开发的肉质球果对它们的口味也很有吸引力。
descriptions.en: While they are mostly carnivorous, the meaty, bulbous fruits our researchers developed appeal to their tastes.

descriptions.zh:
晶态实体很可能是活的。

或许称它们为“硅酸活体物质”更为恰当，因为它们与常见的生物或是传统人造生命大相径庭。

这些实体似乎并不繁殖，并且我们所观察到的晶体在年龄上似乎都没有什么差别。与一个早期假设相反的是，晶态实体个体所发生的色调转变似乎与其年龄无关，而是受其潜在的内部电荷影响——而且可以被猛烈地释放——而偶尔产生的能源波动会改变晶体的折射特性。
descriptions.en:
The Crystalline Entities are probably alive.

A perhaps more descriptive name for them is "silicate-animate matter," as they have little in common with biological or traditionally artificial life.

The Entities do not seem to mate, and we have yet to observe any Crystals that are recognizably older or younger than others. Contrary to an early hypothesis, the shifts in hue between individual Crystalline Entities seem to be related not to their age but to their latent internal charge - which can be violently unleashed - and it appear as if though sporadic fluctuations in this charge alter the refractive properties of the Crystal.

descriptions.zh:
晶态实体——这是[Root.Capital.GetName]的外星生物学家跟外星地质学家互相妥协后所决定的名字——它们确实是生命体。

一部分过于保守的[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]学术精英认为它们是“硅酸盐活性物质”，跟生命体没什么共同之处。

[Root.GetName]的大部分民众不认同这种观点，而是开始赞叹这种晶态实体所代表的新概念。它们是一种单独生活的生物，每一个母体结晶通常只会带着一个哨兵以及一小队晶体军团。除了明显服从领袖命令的哨兵和军团之外，我们对于晶态实体的社会分层是一无所知——这个课题在[Root.Capital.GetName]引发了一场热烈探讨。

晶体似乎不会繁殖，而且我们还没有发现它们的个体之间有明显的年龄差别。跟早前的推论不同，晶体的不同颜色与它们的年龄无关，而是受到内部的潜在变化而改变——而这种变化可以被释放出来——这种偶尔的波动会改变晶体的反射属性。
descriptions.en:
The Crystalline Entities - the name itself a compromise between rival factions of xeno-biologists and xeno-geologists on [Root.Capital.GetName] - are most definitely alive.

Some overly-conservative members of the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] academic elite argue that they are "silicate-animate matter," and that they have little in common with biological life.

Most of the [Root.GetName] populace rejects that regressive perspective, instead turning their view toward the fascinating new horizons that the Crystalline Entities represent. They are, somewhat regrettably, solitary beings, each individual Crystal Sovereign rarely seen with more than one Sentinel and a smaller Cohort entity. Aside from the Cohort and Sentinel clearly being subservient to the Sovereign of the group, the subtle nuances of the Crystalline Entities' socio-hierarchical relationships are lost on us - which does not stop these dynamics from being the subject of fevered study on [Root.Capital.GetName].

The Entities do not seem to mate, and we have yet to observe any Crystals that are recognizably older or younger than others. Contrary to an early hypothesis, the shifts in hue between individual Crystalline Entities seem to be related not to their age but to their latent internal charge - which can be violently unleashed - and it appear as if though sporadic fluctuations in this charge alter the refractive properties of the Crystal.

晶体似乎不会繁殖，而且我们还没有发现它们的个体之间有明显的年龄差别。跟早前的推论不同，晶体的不同颜色与它们的年龄无关，而是受到内部的潜在变化而改变——而这种变化可以被释放出来——这种偶尔的波动会改变晶体的反射属性。晶态实体可以对指定的目标释放这种波动，而且很不幸的，它们似乎热衷于对任何靠近的陌生种群如此做。

The Crystalline Entities are capable of violently discharging at specific target, and unfortunately seem to prefer to do so rather than let foreign entities pass by unscathed.

descriptions.en: The Crystalline Entities seem to resonate in response to something; one of their few interactions with their environment. The exact nature and possible wider purpose of this emitted waveform has yet to be ascertained, but for now our ships can approximate it using radio pings, essentially camouflaging themselves as fellow Crystals.

descriptions.zh: 为这些生物培育美味的果实颇具挑战。我们还不确定它们是在吃我们创造的玻璃状的球果，还是只是因为被其光滑的表面所吸引而随身携带。无论如何这都能满足我们的需求了。
descriptions.en: Developing a palatable fruit for these creatures has been a challenge. We're not sure if they're eating the glass-like pomes we created or if they just like to carry them around, enamored by their glossy surfaces. That's enough for our needs.

我们在[From.GetName]观测到大量晶状生命体的出现。这很明显是某种巢穴——或者至少是晶状生命体的聚集地，就如在[From.GetName]有一个我们从未见过的晶状结构。

descriptions.en:
We see significant crystalline presence in the [From.GetName] system. Evidently some kind of den - or at least a hub of crystalline activity, such as it is - [From.GetName] is home to a crystal construct unlike any previously encountered.

This construct exhibits several properties associated with the crystalline entities, but greatly exaggerated.

descriptions.zh:

目前的读数表明，如果能够将这些不寻常的晶体结构……拆开的话，应该会拥有一定的研究价值，
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports a significant crystalline presence in the [From.GetName] system. There is little to indicate whether this is an ancestral home of the creatures, but never before have this many crystalline entities been observed in one system at once.

Initial readings point to the unusual crystal construct in the system being of some interest, should we be able to... disassemble it.

descriptions.zh:
无人机在其小行星上永无休止地对不断减少的资源进行开采。对其进行研究的过程较为枯燥，但仍具有研究价值。事实上，我们可以学到如何在最大化开采效率的同时减少能源消耗。

另外，我们发现无人机并非完全处于静默。它们会发出脉冲信号，不过频率极低并且波长很难与背景杂讯区分开来。是否有人在接收这些脉冲信号就不得而知了。
descriptions.en:
The drones and their tireless, endless work of extracting ever-diminishing resources from their local planetoids make for a somewhat dull, but nevertheless informative subject of study. In fact, we could stand to learn a thing or two about maximizing mineral extraction rates while conserving energy.

Additionally, we have found that the drones are not completely silent. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. Whether there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery better left for another time.

descriptions.zh:
除了对[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]飞船进行威胁的时候，这些无人机只会进行机械化的采矿工作。

但有趣的是，这些无人机并不是完全静默，它们会发射出声脉冲信号，不知道这些信号到底是发给谁的。
descriptions.en:
When not posturing with their mining lasers aimed at [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] ships, the drones appear steadfast and dumbly hard-working, hacking away at mineral-poor asteroids for want of something better to do.

What is more interesting is that the drones are not completely silent, contrary to earlier assumptions. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. If there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery for another time.

descriptions.zh:
这些无人机的挖掘效率比十分优秀，要是[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的矿工的话，这些地方可能早就被认为是挖无可挖了。我们的高级工程师正在将这些无人机的运作方式应用在[Root.GetName]的复合矿场和太空港中以增加我们的采矿效率，减少能源浪费。

但有趣的是，这些无人机并不是完全静默，它们会发射出声脉冲信号，虽然不是非常频繁，但用的却是一种很难从杂音中识别出的信号。不知道这些信号到底是发给谁的。
descriptions.en:
The drones are remarkably efficient at squeezing ever-diminishing returns from rocks [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] miners would have soon discarded, deemed exhausted of all worthwhile mineral content. Our top engineers are working on adapting the drones' methodology for use in the [Root.GetName]'s Mining Networks and Stations which should improve efficiency, effectively lessening energy expenditure.

Of lesser import is the fact that the drones are not completely silent, contrary to previous assumptions. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. If there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery for another time.

descriptions.zh:
无人机在他们所在的小行星上永无休止的对不断减少的资源进行开采，这一单调的过程很值得研究。[Root.Capital.GetName]上的复合矿场可以从中学到如何在保存能源的同时最大化的提取矿物。

此外，这些无人机并不是完全静默，它们会偶尔发射声脉冲信号，而且这些声脉冲信号的波长很难和背景杂音区分开，是否有人收到这些声脉冲就不得而知了。
descriptions.en:
The drones and their tireless, endless work of extracting ever-diminishing resources from their local planetoids make for a somewhat dull, but nevertheless informative subject of study. In fact, Mining Networks on [Root.Capital.GetName] could stand to learn a thing or two about maximizing mineral extraction rates while conserving energy.

Additionally, we have found that the drones are not completely silent. They emit signal pings, though extremely infrequently and at a wavelength hard to isolate from background noise. If there is anyone left to receive these pings may be a mystery for another time.

descriptions.zh:
虚空之云可能是宇宙中最古老的存在之一。在宇宙中刚开始形成物质之后仅仅数十亿年里，它们似乎就已经出现了，这是年轻宇宙用强大的力量凭空创造出来的产物，它们本可以成为恒星，但却没有。

它们动物般的智慧可能更加难以解释，但答案或许就在维持其形态的强大电磁场中——另一个宇宙诞生之初的产物。只要有足够长的时间，它奇怪的星尘与引力场循环完全有可能会形成类似神经网络或是计算机电路的东西。

而且，这些虚空之云似乎在互相发送脉冲信号，甚至可能是在进行沟通，尽管彼此之间的距离以光年计算。我们怀疑这一现象可能与量子纠缠有关。
descriptions.en:
The Void Clouds may be among the oldest entities in the universe. They seem to have originated just a scant few billion years after matter as we know it first appeared, the tremendous forces of the young cosmos making something out of nothing. They would have been stars once, but were not.

Explaining their apparent animal intelligence is more difficult, but the answer might lie in the abnormally strong electromagnetic fields that keep them together - another product of their primordial beginnings. It is not inconceivable that, given enough time, the circulation of its strange stardust and gravitic fields aligned in a flexible approximation of neural pathways or computational circuits.

Moreover, the Clouds seem to be receiving impulses from one another, if not outright communicating, lightyears apart. Quantum entanglement is suspected to play a role in this phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
虚空之云是宇宙的观察者，在了解了虚空之云的特征之后，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的宇航员在宇宙各地都发现了虚空之云的踪迹。

它们产生于万物初始的时候，观察着恒星闪耀、行星新生。现在它们在宇宙间漫无目的地移动着，似乎在有意识地收集过去留下的残骸，在死去的恒星和破碎的世界之间漂流。

它们的存在时刻提醒着我们自己是多么的渺小。
descriptions.en:
The Void Clouds are stewards of the cosmos. Once [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] astronomers knew what to look for, they found traces of the Void Clouds everywhere.

Formed at the dawn of creation, they stood watch as stars were lit and young planets formed. Now they drift, quasi-conscious agglomerations of inanimate matter from the earliest hours of time itself, afloat between dying stars and breaking worlds.

They are a constant reminder that we are but all small parts of something greater.

descriptions.zh:
目前，[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]的研究者认为虚空之云是宇宙中最古老的存在，它们似乎是在宇宙诞生仅仅几十亿年后出现的，这是年轻宇宙用强大的力量凭空创造出来的产物，它们本可以成为恒星，但却没有。

想要解释它们那种原始的动物本能更是困难，但答案的关键可能就在将它们紧密结合在一起的异常强大的电磁场中——这也是在它们出现的时候就存在的东西。可以预见，只要有足够的时间，它奇怪的星尘和引力场循环将会变得和神经回路一样。

还有，尽管彼此之间相距数光年的距离，虚空之云似乎在互相发送脉冲波，这之中可能存在量子纠缠的现象。
descriptions.en:
The Void Clouds are, as far as [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] researchers can tell, among the oldest entities in the universe. They seem to have originated just a scant few billion years after matter as we know it first appeared, the tremendous forces of the young cosmos making something out of nothing. They would have been stars once, but were not.

Explaining their apparent animal intelligence is more difficult, but the answer might lie in the abnormally strong electromagnetic fields that keep them together - another product of their primordial beginnings. It is not inconceivable that, given enough time, the circulation of its strange stardust and gravitic fields aligned in a flexible approximation of neural pathways.

Moreover, the Clouds seem to be receiving impulses from one another, if not outright communicating, lightyears apart. Quantum entanglement is suspected to play a role in this phenomenon.
